text: When the factory can't read a gate's job, it says so once, instead of asking again on every poll. D-0081 has the factory read a failed gate's job to tell whether it ran, since GitHub fails a job it never gives a runner. Reading a job needs the App's Actions permission, which the App was never given. So on copythis-ad#38, whose gate failed for lack of a runner when the account's minutes ran out, the watcher got a 403 every 30 seconds and never posted. Now GitHub's refusal is its own error, set apart from a rate limit, which waiting fixes. The factory posts that the gate failed, that it can't tell whether the job ran, and how to go on, and it doesn't merge. The App's setup page adds Actions, read-only.
